title: Electrical engineering
summary: The discipline of making electricity and information do useful work.

layers.basics: Electrical engineers design everything from power grids to phone chips by understanding voltage, current, fields and signals.
layers.deeper: The curriculum climbs from maths and physics through circuits, electronics, digital logic, signals, fields and control to specialised applications.
layers.expert: Unifying ideas: linearity and superposition, frequency-domain thinking, feedback, energy conservation and abstraction layers from devices to systems.
